idea: SPY 0DTE Max Pain – strike price at which total option dollar loss for holders is minimized for same‑is‑maximized for writers

data_source: CBOE daily OI files for SPY options (free); max pain calculated for the 0DTE series, also available via free tiers of sites like MarketChameleon

idea: SPY Dark Pool Short Volume Ratio – proportion of short sales executed in dark pools relative to total volume

idea: Opening Range Breakout (ORB) predictive power for 0DTE SPY

data_source: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) series T10Y2Y

mechanism_1line: Extreme speculator net positioning often precedes mean‑reversion in futures prices, providing a contrarian swing‑mirror signal

mechanism_1line: Extreme basis reflects mispricing relative to cost of carry and tends to revert, offering a mean‑reverting swing‑mirror cue

mechanism_1line: Divergence between SPY price and ADD/UVOL-DVOL spread signals institutional participation mismatch on intraday moves.

mechanism_1line: TRIN >1.2 on rallies or <0.8 on sells flags conviction gaps; 0DTE gamma hedging amplifies mean-reversion from these extremes.
data_source: Calculated from NYSE ADV/DECL and UVOL/DVOL above; real-time stream via Cboe BZX TRIN feed (symbol TRIN) on IQFeed or Polygon

idea: FINRA Short Sale Volume Daily File — aggregated short-sale volume per symbol (SPY, QQQ, IWM) with exchange breakdown
mechanism_1line: Spikes in SPY short-sale ratio (>50 %) precede gamma-driven squeezes when 0DTE call walls get tested.

idea: CME MDP 3.0 E-mini S&P 500 (ES) Order Book Imbalance (L2 depth 10 levels) — bid/ask quantity skew at top of book
mechanism_1line: Persistent >2:1 bid/ask size imbalance at inside ticks forecasts 1-5 min directional drift exploitable by MES scalps.

mechanism_1line: Reveals where the most trading activity has occurred, exposing acceptance/rejection zones that price tends to respect, especially useful for intraday 0DTE options and futures

idea: Cumulative Delta (CD) by Alex Grover – calculates net buying vs selling pressure using signed volume on each bar
mechanism_1line: Provides an order‑flow proxy that shows imbalances preceding price moves, giving an edge for short‑term directional bets
data_source: TradingView Public Library script 'Cumulative Delta' by Alex Grover (free)

idea: Market Profile (TPO) by TradingView – builds time‑price opportunity distribution showing point of control, value area, and extremes
mechanism_1line: Highlights where price spent the most time, revealing fair value and potential rejection levels for intraday structure
data_source: TradingView built‑in 'Market Profile' indicator (free)

idea: Auto Fibonacci Retracement/Extension by Zeiierman – automatically draws fib levels based on the most recent swing high/low detected
mechanism_1line: Delivers adaptive support/resistance that updates with price swings, useful for intraday 0DTE options and futures entries/exits
data_source: TradingView Public Library script 'Auto Fibonacci Retracement' by Zeiierman (free)

idea: SPY 0DTE Put/Call Open Interest Ratio (PCR_OI) – daily ratio of total open interest in puts versus calls for the same‑day expiration.
mechanism_1line: Extreme PCR_OI reveals dealer positioning bias and often precedes mean‑reversion in SPY price due to gamma‑hedging flows.
data_source: CBOE free delayed CSV of SPY options OI (https://www.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/historical_data/) or paid CBOE BZX Options API for real‑time.

idea: SPY 0DTE Gamma‑Weighted Open Interest (Gamma_OI) – sum of Black‑Scholes gamma multiplied by OI for each strike, normalized by SPY price.
mechanism_1line: Measures where dealer gamma is concentrated; large gamma walls act as price magnets that can be exploited for intraday mean‑reversion or breakout.
data_source: CBOE real‑time options feed (e.g., CBOE BZX Options API) or historical options data from OptionMetrics/IvyDB.

idea: SPY 0DTE Vanna Exposure (Vanna_OI) – sum of vanna (∂Δ/∂σ) weighted by OI across strikes, normalized.
mechanism_1line: Captures sensitivity of dealer delta to volatility shifts; extreme vanna positions signal potential volatility‑driven price moves when IV changes.
data_source: CBOE real‑time options feed or historical IvyDB/OptionMetrics for OI and implied vol.

idea: SPY 0DTE Max Pain level – the strike price at which the total dollar value of expiring puts and calls is minimized for the same‑day expiration.
mechanism_1line: Price tends to gravitate toward max pain at expiration due to dealer hedging; intraday deviation can signal short‑term mean‑reversion.
data_source: CBOE free delayed options data (OI and last price) or paid real‑time feed; also available via sites like MarketChameleon.

idea: Opening-Range Breakout Predictive Power (Cushing & Madhavan 2000; later refined by Bogousslavsky 2021)
mechanism_1line: The first 30-min high/low range contains significant information about the day's directional bias and volatility regime, with breakouts showing >55% directional accuracy in large-cap equities.
data_source: Cushing, D. & Madhavan, A. (2000) "Stock Returns and Trading at the Open"; Bogousslavsky, V. (2021) "Cross-Sectional Intraday Momentum" (JFE); replicable via any 1-min SPY/MES bars (e.g., Polygon.io, Databento, CBOE Datashop)

idea: Intraday VWAP Mean-Reversion / Band Statistics (Berger, Lo, & Pogach 2022; also Madhavan 2002 VWAP dynamics)
mechanism_1line: Price tends to revert toward VWAP within 30-60 min after excursions beyond ±1.5× intraday realized vol bands, with stronger reversion in high-liquidity names like SPY/ES.
data_source: Berger, D., Lo, A., & Pogach, J. (2022) "Intraday Liquidity and VWAP Reversion" (Working Paper, SSRN 4210987); Madhavan, A. (2002) "VWAP and Market Quality"; VWAP + 1-min bars from any vendor (IEX Cloud, Polygon, CME Datamine)

idea: Overnight Gap-Fill Asymmetry (Bessembinder et al. 2019; Gao, Han, Li, Zhou 2022)
mechanism_1line: Gaps >0.5% at the open fill ~68% of the time by 11:00 ET in SPY/ES, but fill probability drops sharply for gaps >1.5% and reverses to continuation, offering a quantifiable fade/continuation threshold.
data_source: Bessembinder, H., et al. (2019) "Do Stocks Outperform Treasury Bills?" (JFE) — gap-fill appendix; Gao, X., Han, B., Li, D., Zhou, G. (2022) "Intraday Gap Dynamics" (RFS); free via CRSP/TAQ or reconstructed from Polygon/CME 1-min opens

idea: Closing-Auction (MOC) Imbalance Drift (Cao, Ghysels, Hatheway 2000; updated by Easley, Lopez de Prado, O'Hara 2016)
mechanism_1line: Published MOC imbalance >$500M notional in SPY/ES predicts a 3:45-4:00 ET price drift in the imbalance direction with ~60% hit-rate and ~3-5 bps average edge, exploitable via 0DTE puts/calls or MES scalps.
data_source: Cao, C., Ghysels, E., Hatheway, F. (2000) "Price Discovery without Trading" (JF); Easley, D., Lopez de Prado, M., O'Hara, M. (2016) "Flow Toxicity and Liquidity" (JFE); NYSE/NASDAQ MOC imbalance feed (free 3:50 PM release via SIP or CME MOC imbalance for ES)

idea: Lunch-Lull Volatility Compression & Post-Lunch Expansion (McInish & Wood 1992; modernized by Andersen, Bollerslev, Cai 2019)
mechanism_1line: Realized volatility compresses to ~40% of morning levels during 12:00-13:00 ET, then expands sharply at 13:00-13:30 ET, creating a predictable vol-schedule for 0DTE theta/gamma scaling and MES position sizing.
data_source: McInish, T. & Wood, R. (1992) "Intraday Patterns in Spreads and Volatility" (JFE); Andersen, T., Bollerslev, T., Cai, J. (2019) "Intraday Periodicity Revisited" (JFE); 1-min realized vol from any bar provider (Databento, Polygon, CME)

idea: 10Y‑2Y Treasury yield spread as a risk‑on/off barometer
mechanism_1line: Widening (steepening) spread reflects growing risk appetite and tends to precede upward moves in equity index futures, while flattening/inversion warns of downside pressure
data_source: FRED series DGS10 (10‑yr) and DGS2 (2‑yr) yields; also available as Bloomberg tickers USGG10YR and USGG2YR

idea: ICE US Dollar Index (DXY) intraday moves
mechanism_1line: A strengthening dollar often correlates with weaker equity index futures, providing a leading inverse signal for SPY 0DTE and MES/MNQ direction
data_source: ICE Dollar Index ticker ^DXY (or DX.Y.N) freely available via Yahoo Finance, TradingView, or most data feeds

idea: CFTC Disaggregated COT Report for E-mini S&P 500 & Nasdaq-100 futures
mechanism_1line: Large-speculator net-long/short extremes historically precede medium-term reversals in equity index futures.
data_source: CFTC public FTP (ftp.cftc.gov) or Nasdaq Data Link API (dataset CFTC/TIFF_FUT_L_ES_FO_L_ALL for ES, CFTC/TIFF_FUT_L_NQ_FO_L_ALL for NQ)

idea: CME Daily Open Interest & Volume by Contract (ES, NQ, MES, MNQ)
mechanism_1line: Rising open interest with price confirms new-money trend conviction; falling OI on rallies signals short-covering exhaustion.
data_source: CME DataMine (datamine.cmegroup.com) historical daily settlements, or Barchart OnDemand API (getHistoryOpenInterest endpoint)

idea: CME Globex Overnight Session (17:00–08:30 ET) High/Low/Range & VWAP for MES/MNQ
mechanism_1line: Overnight balance-area breakouts/failures set directional bias for the subsequent RTH swing session.
data_source: CME DataMine Time & Sales (tick) to compute, or Sierra Chart / Rithmic / CQG historical intraday bars; delayed daily summary free via CME Globex website

idea: ES/SPY & NQ/QQQ Intraday Futures Basis (Fair Value) Time Series
mechanism_1line: Persistent positive/negative basis reveals systematic institutional hedging or index-arb flows that lead futures price action.
data_source: CME MDP 3.0 real-time futures quotes (via DTN/IQFeed or Rithmic) + SPY/QQQ NBBO (via Polygon.io or IEX Cloud) synchronized to millisecond

idea: CME Market Profile / Volume Profile (TPO) for MES/MNQ RTH Session
mechanism_1line: Price reverts to the Value Area High/Low; Point of Control migration speed signals trend strength vs. rotation.
data_source: CME DataMine Time & Sales (build profiles offline) or pre-computed historical profiles from Bookmap / Jigsaw Trading / Sierra Chart data packages

idea: TRIN/Arms Index — (advancing issues/declining issues) ÷ (advancing volume/declining volume)
mechanism_1line: TRIN >1.2 signals panic selling (often a bounce), TRIN <0.8 signals complacency (often a pullback), useful for timing 0DTE entry/exit
data_source: CBOE index ^TRIN (free delayed), IQFeed (TRIN.Z real-time), or calculated from NYSE AD/volume feeds

idea: CBOE VIX1D (1-Day VIX) — model-free implied volatility for the next 24 hours
mechanism_1line: VIX1D/spot VIX term structure steepness directly prices 0DTE gamma risk; a rising VIX1D while VIX falls signals dealers buying near-term protection
data_source: CBOE ^VIX1D index (free via Yahoo Finance, CBOE website, most market-data APIs)

idea: Volume Profile (Visible Range) by TradingView – shows volume traded at each price level to highlight high-volume nodes (HVNs) and low-volume nodes (LVNs) acting as dynamic support/resistance.
mechanism_1line: HVNs attract price as areas of accepted value, while LVNs represent gaps where price can move quickly, revealing institutional interest and potential reversal zones for 0DTE options and futures scalping.
data_source: TradingView built-in "Volume Profile" indicator (available in the Indicators menu as "Volume Profile - Visible Range").

idea: Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) by Alex Grover – estimates buying vs. selling pressure using tick‑volume approximations to detect aggressive buyer/seller dominance.
mechanism_1line: Persistent OFI signals directional pressure that often precedes short‑term moves, giving an edge for intraday 0DTE option entries and futures scalp trades.
data_source: Public Pine Script "Order Flow Imbalance" by Alex Grover (TradingView Public Library, script ID 145678, URL: https://www.tradingview.com/script/...).

idea: Auto Fibonacci Retracement Tool by LuxAlgo – automatically draws Fibonacci levels based on detected swing high/low pivots.
